batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MG Johnson

batting.name: GH Vihari
batting.dismissal: c MG Johnson b SL Malinga

batting.name: KD Karthik

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: st PA Patel b KV Sharma

balls.text: poor end, lands on a length and White thrashes that flat over the deep extra cover boundary
they get a bye, full toss outside off and he swings and misses, just a single
appeal for a catch, Karthik goes up again, clean catch but not sure there was contact with the bat, Thisara moved across to scoop it, missed
good stuff, yorker length outside off, Perera tries to swing that over the leg side, misses
quick full toss on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
yorker length outside off, dug out over the bowler towards long-on for a single
yorker length outside off, White tries to open the face on that one, misses, excellent stuff, just five off that
Perera starts well but Pollard is standing quite straight at long-off, driven hard but on the bounce to the fielder there
full outside off, slices that square towards deep point for a single
full and wide and he tries to smash that over long-off, has to reach for it, misses, called a wide
shortish on the off and he tries to flat-bat that over mid-off, can't get it that far, Johnson runs back to take a well-judged catch
bowled it full outside off, slices it towards deep point for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, slapped towards mid-off for a single
Johnson's spell ends in disappointment for the bowler, ends up bowling a slower ball that serves as a long hop and White has bludgeoned it over the deep midwicket boundary

appeal for a catch, went for the pull and there was a sound as it went past White's bat, Karthik tok it on the half-volley and he appealed, he claimed the catch, replays showed that clearly fell short, there was a puff of dust as it landed as well, that's not out
slower one bowled short on the off, runs that down to third man for a single
slower one bowled full outside off, made room to launch him over extra cover, missed
dropped, Rayudu spills it running in from deep point, slices that full slower ball and Rayudu ran in and looked like he was in control but just couldn't hold on
another start to a new spell, another boundary, short on middle and that's been pulled imperiously over midwicket
yorker length outside off, dug out towards cover for a single

low full toss again  and Pollard does a brilliant job running to his right from long-on, White drove it through midwicket, he rain a fair distance and dived full length to his right and pulled it back in, superb stuff
aiming for a yorker, turns out to be a low full toss on leg, driven towards deep square leg
full toss and that's creamed but straight towards deep cover for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away towards point, Harbhajan dives to his left and stops that
low full toss outside off, pushes that towards long-off for a single
miscues it this time, comes down the track, the bat turns in his hand as he tries to hit that, ends up going towards deep midwicket
and White responds to that stare with a six, tossed up, he charged out and launched him over the bowler's head for a clean six
makes room and the bowler chases him, cracks it back towards the bowler, Ojha responds with a stare
made room to hit that over midwicket, mistimed it towards long-on for a single
takes that one from outside off and drags it square into the deep for a couple more runs
tossed up and Vihari collects a boundary, slog-sweeping that over midwicket
this one was hammered alright, length ball for White, sat up nicely and he absolutely blasted that over the bowler's head for a one bounce four
drops that short and White somehow manages to drag that over midwicket, not very well hit but finds the gap
bowled that full on the off, drives that towards long-off for a single
short on the off, mistimes that pull towards deep square leg for a single
on a good length, crunched towards deep point for a single
picks up a four, Dhawal drops short on middle and pulls it away over midwicket, nicely struck, found the gap
floating it on middle, gets across and turns it fine for a single, towards short fine
slaps that one towards deep cover for a single
tossed up on leg stump, sweeps it on the bounce towards deep backward square leg
this time there's a single, knocks it in front of extra cover and sets off
floating it on middle, gets forward and taps it towards extra cover for a single, or so we thought, he was sent back, there was no run there
tossed up, comes down the track and strikes it on the bounce towards long-on for a single
on a good length and that's been defended solidly back to the bowler
gone, Johnson dismisses Dhawan with a slower ball, Dhawan charged out to Johnson there, and pushed loosely at it after realising that was the slower one, gets an nick and Karthik takes it easily
slower one bowled short outside off, chops that one down towards third man
shortish outside off, cracks it towards deep cover for a single, slower one bowled short
slightly short on middle, plays it to the right of Tendulkar at midwicket for a single
poor ball, he's had a bad game,short and wide and Vihari easily cuts it over point
shortish on middle, pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single
slides that one down the leg side after Vihari gives himself some room
struck hard but straight to deep backward square leg, just the single again
sweeps that one down towards deep backward square leg for a single
tossed up on leg stump from round the wicket, tries to reverse-sweep, ends up playing it to extra cover
shortish on middle, makes room to cut that towards deep point for a single
slightly short on middle, turns it square for a single
is that six? No, just landed short of the boundary, slower one bowled short and Dhawan steps out to slash that viciously over point for a one bounce four
what a shot, and what a way to bring up his fifty, pitched up and he creams it through the covers
banged in short on middle and he sways out of the way, thought of pulling it initially but wisely backed out, quick from Malinga
slower one bowled on the pads, flicked away square, Smith runs across and keeps them to two, diving to his left
slower one bowled short, chopped  behind point for a single
low full toss on middle, digs it out towards midwicket
slow and short outside off, guides that wide of Tendulkar at short third for a single
moved well across and tried to scoop that fine, almost falls over, just the single to square leg
the offcutter from Pollard and Dhawan smartly opens the face at the last moment to late cut that to the third-man boundary
slower one bowled on the off, knocks that one down towards point and races off
takes it from the off stump and clips it square, runs hard for the second and makes it in time
driven neatly towards long-off for a single
gets forward and tickles that one towards short fine leg, no run there
tossed up, drives that one down towards long-on for a single
superb, flat on middle and he had picked this spot, reverse-slaps that between short third and point
taps that one in front of point and races through for a single
flat on leg stump, turned towards square leg for a single
back of a length on middle, knocks it down into the leg side, thought of a single, was wisely sent back
angling in towards leg stump, tries to work it square, strikes him on the pads
comes down the track, full outside off and he creams that towards deep cover for a single
slower one, comes down the track and slashes that towards point, Pollard dives to his right and stops it
that's been smashed with disdain, on a good length outside off and he cracks that hard through point, fiercely struck
superbly timed, pitched up from round the wicket, driven sweetly wide of extra cover, Smith in the deep runs across and keeps them down to a couple
on the pads, played towards short fine for a single
angling in towards middle, defended it into the leg side towards square leg for a single
flatter on the off, gets forward defends it to point for a single
that's been hammered, into the second tier of the Sunil Gavaskar Stand, took it from the off stump and slog-swept it miles
floating it on middle, tickled in the direction of square leg for a single
tossed up on the off, drives it down the ground for a single
holds its line on the off stump, taps it towards point for a single
quicker through the air, on middle and leg and he sweeps it fine this tine, between short fine and square leg
don't know what Karthik was appealing for there, Dhawan gets forward, that was sliding down leg as he tried to play that square, missed, would have gone down
angling in on middle and leg, chips that one over midwicket for a couple of runs
tossed up on the off, gets forward and drives it back to the bowler
slides that one down the leg side, tries to sweep it fine, misses, called a wide
floating it on middle, comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler
nicely timed, not much respite for Johnson, bowled full outside off, leans forward and square-drives that between point and cover
lands it on a good length on middle and off, gets across and pushes that wide of mid-on
that was quick, good, sharp bouncer banged in on middle and he ducks under that one
shortish on the off, rocks on the back foot and taps it towards gully from the crease
slower one bowled short outside off, cut past a diving point into the deep for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, defended towards point, no run on offer
on the pads and that's been flicked towards deep square leg for a single
Malinga has got rid of Parthiv, good, sharp, short ball and he went for the pull, didn't play it well, offered a simple catch to Rayudu at deep square leg
back of a length outside off and he tries to upper-cut that over the slips, too quick this time and he misses
ooh, nicely played, full outside off and he steered that nicely but point stopped it
dropped, Dhawal spills one at mid-off, slower one and Parthiv drives it uppishly towards mid-off, Dhawal was there, he bent low and stretched forward and failed to clasp it
the slower one, lands on a good length on middle, gets forward and defends it into the off side
gets back and chops that one down into the off side
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and punches it to the bowler
rocks forward and defends that one towards point
round the wicket and that slides down the leg side, called a wide
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and works it square for a quick single
flighted on middle, clipped through midwicket into the deep for a single, a direct hit to the striker's end and they steal an overthrow
tossed up on the off, gets forward and defends it in front of point for a single
ooh, goes hard at that one, shortish and he slashes hard but can't make contact
superbly driven, pitched up outside off and Parthiv, who looks in fine form, dispatches that, gets to the pitch and cracks it hard past Rohit at short point, was too quick for him to react
gets forward and pushes it past extra cover for a quick single
that's over the ropes, short and wide and he slashes hard, flies off the outside edge over the slips and over the boundary
drives that one on the up, on a good length, rocks forward and cracks it towards point
in the channel outside off stump, short of a good length and Dhawan lets it be
short of a good length outside off and he leaves it be, called a wide, marginal call, seemed within the line
now through midwicket, four more, lovely batting from Parthiv, Johnson bowls it straight on middle, Parthiv gets across and just punches it through midwicket
excellent start this, short of a length outside off, Parthiv gets on the back foot and crunches it through point for a boundary, just eased it through that gap
picks the gap, too straight from Johnson, Parthiv gets across and flicks it uppishly through square leg for a boundary
down the leg side, tried to flick that fine, missed, called a wide
nicely driven, pitched up, some away swing there, gets to the pitch and drives it square, but well fielded by Smith at point
shuffled across and took it from middle, clipped it through square leg for a couple of runs
Lovely shot, meaty delivery on the pads and that's driven through midwicket for a boundary, stylish drive
oh dear, what domination, what ruthlessness, what carnage, dropped that short and that's been smashed to pulp and sent back over deep square leg
dot ball, dropped it short on middle, tried to pull, missed
another six, low full toss and he swings it hard over deep midwicket, his top hand came off there as he made contact, all over
slower one bowled slightly short outside off, defended towards point
well fielded by White at extra cover, bowled it full outside off, makes room and drives it towards him, just the single
short and Pollard pulls that along the ground wide of Ishant at fine leg for a couple of runs
Steyn is trying hard, bowled it at 147.5kmph outside off, tries to strike it hard down the ground, misses
slower one bowled short outside off, tapped towards point for a single
on a good length on leg stump, pushed past the bowler for a single
Pollard has just changed things completely, slaps that towards long-off for a single
He's lost his bat, it has slipped out of his hand, flat outside off and he swings, misses, and loses his bat, landed just wide of the leg umpire, was in the firing line there
poor, poor stuff this, this game is as good as over, no-ball for height, full toss, above the waist and Pollard slams him over deep square leg
can't make it six in six, was the googly and he tried to go over midwicket there, swung hard and missed as it turned in
five sixes in a row for Pollard, tossed up outside off, makes room and launches that miles over extra cover, that's disappeared, just under the roof
tossed up and that's been thwacked, plenty of air on that one and Pollard reached forward to send that hard over long-on
tossed up outside off, mistimes a drive towards deep cover for a single
doesn't help, another length delivery and Pollard is not entirely in control of this one, or so we think, it's struck hard enough to clear wide long-on
identical result, Perera, after those two short balls, now doles out length and Pollard dispatches him flat over his head
that was done with ease, the flattest of sixes, length ball on middle and he drills that hard, Sammy is pretty straight and he leaps but that just clears him and crashes into the sightscreen
Pollard cashes in this time, Perera is bowling gifts here, thrashed over midwicket for a one bounce four
meaty drive but struck straight to long-off for a single
doles out a long hop, poor, poor delivery, slower one bowled short and Rohit murders that over the deep midwicket boundary, second tier again, he can hit them miles
shortish and that ends an excellent over, pushed through midwicket, Steyns runs all the way across but can't prevent them from taking the second
taken by surprise, wanted to evade it initially but then decided to play it, tried to fend it and it struck the handle, landed safe in front of point
nicely done there by Rohit, pulled it towards deep square leg for a single, pulled it Lara-style with one leg in the air
lovely stuff from Steyn, 142.5kmph, short of a length, Rohit looks to cut but that's too quick for him
Pollard steps across to try to whip it square, Steyn runs all the way towards square leg to keep them down to a single

Jaffaaaa, ooh, just spat away from a good length, good bounce too and squared him up completely, a superb delivery and Pollard had no answer to that, would have done well to get some bat to it and he couldn't
full on the off, aiming for the blockhole, almost gets it right, dug out towards cover for a single
mid-off is inside the circle and Pollard's flat-batted hit finds the boundary, just clears that fielder in the in-field
slower length ball outside off, dabbed to backward point for a single
Rohit can hit them long, short and he pulled that hard and it slammed into the board of the second tier, the Sunil Gavaskar stand, Ishant lost his balance and fell
slower one bowled short outside off, pushed that towards extra cover
on middle and leg and that's turned to fine leg for a single
the googly, Rohit was caught by surprise there, made room to cut but was eventually cramped for room, managed to chop it towards point
smashed towards long-on but Ishant does well to get his body behind that one, powerfully hit past the non-striker
ooh, down the leg side and it's not called a wide, may not have been too far from leg stump there
floating it outside off stump, Pollard rocks forward and defends it cautiously into the off side

stumped and Mumbai have reason to worry, comes down the track to play it away into the leg side, that was pushed through, missed and Parthiv collected it well as Rayudu would have blocked his view for a moment, took off the bails quickly
sliding on leg stump, gets forward to play it into the leg side, clips the pads
shortish on the off, slapped towards long-off for a single

appeal for a catch, the umpire shakes his head, both keeper and bowler went up immediately after Rayudu missed the pull, may have flicked the shoulder, the sleeve, hard to say there, tough call, can't really blame umpire Chaudhry there, really difficult to make out if there was any contact with the bat
full on the off, driven firmly towards long-on for a single
slightly short outside off, comes down the track and guides that one to third man for a single
slightly short on middle, pulls it stylishly towards deep square leg for a single
short of a good length on middle, knocks it down into the off side

Karthik goes, a double-setback this over for Mumbai, tried to turn the face on that flighted delivery, it turned away, took the leading edge and White at extra cover ran forward, dived and took a good low catch
slightly short on the off, punched towards point and they get a single, beats the fielder's dive
delight for the Wankhede crowd as Tendulkar connects superbly, comes down the track and launches that high and handsome over the long-on boundary
shortish outside leg stump, paddles it towards short fine leg
ooh, that was the googly, tried to swing that over midwicket, was tossed up, got a thick inside edge through square leg for a single
Tendulkar comes down the track and converts that into a full toss, smacks that over his head for a boundary
slower one this time, back of the hand on leg stump, tries to turn it into the leg side, given runs as it brushes Tendulkar's pads
that's a wide, too wide outside off and Tendulkar couldn't reach it
banged in short outside off, was a touch too high but that's not called a wide, Tendulkar wasn't happy
comes down the track, takes it from a length and hits it towards long-on, just the single
slower one bowled short and Karthik pulls it into that gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket, powerfully hit
tried to paddle it fine, came down the track, clips the pads, he gets a single to square leg
good stuff, on target on the off stump, defended towards point and he sets off for a single
short, flat, well outside off, was there to pull but Karthik mistimed it to deep midwicket
stopped for a moment before delivering, Tendulkar paddles it to short fine for a single
slipped out, was a full toss and Karthik slams it, but down the ground towards long-on
ooh, didn't connect well, steps out and strikes that towards long-off, was uppish but fell short of the fielder
the googly, turned back in, punched off the back foot to deep point for a single
Tendulkar goes over the top, again was looking to hit it straighter, got it on the bounce to Ishant Sharma at long-on
driving it past the bowler towards long-on for a single, was looking to play that straighter
too wide down the leg side, called by the umpire, that may have slipped out
the bowler followed him this time, shortish and that's been punched back to the bowler
picked his spot there, tossed up and he made room to crash that over extra cover for a one bounce four
fullish on the off, driven towards long-on for a single
flat on middle and that's been defended towards extra cover
lots of air on that one, full on the off, drives it towards long-off for a single
finds the gap, tossed up, he takes it from the off stump and slog-sweeps it hard through midwicket for a boundary
floating it on middle, pushes it through midwicket for a single
flat outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single
quicker through the air, flat on the off, Tendulkar moves back to punch it to long-off
flatter outside off, cracked towards deep cover for one more
tossed up on the off, drives it long-off for a single
shortish outside off, chopped wide of point, the fielder dives to keep them to a single
down the leg side, called a wide as the keeper fumbles and concedes a single

shortish on middle, swivels to play it to short fine, tries to run through for a single, Mishra throws to the non-striker's end and misses, Tendulkar would have been run-out had that been a direct hit
pushes that one uppishly just wide of Sammy for a single to long-off
shortish outside off and he tried to cut that past point, missed
shortish on the off, comes down the track and pulls it square for a couple of runs
cut away, short of a length and he chopped it hard past the diving point fielder to beat third man
angling in towards middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single
steps forward, defends that one towards mid-on and steals a quick single
angling in on middle, pushed wide of mid-on for a single
shortish on the off, tries to smash that through the covers, it came back in and he mistimed it back to the bowler
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and defends it towards extra cover
beaten, drew Tendulkar forward, nipped away from a good length to just go past the outside edge
nips back in from middle, works it off the back foot through square leg for a single
he decides to go over the bowler's head, bowled at 135.2kmph, on middle, was slightly on the shorter side but he decided to go after him, launching him over the bowler's head for a one bounce four
short of a good length and he strikes it on the up towards mid-off, can't get it past him
angling in on middle, Tendulkar rocks forward to defend, gets an inside edge onto the pads, was a little late on that one
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and defends it towards cover
short of a good length, cuts it down towards point
straying on the pads and that's well driven, gets forward and places that past midwicket for a boundary
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and taps it into the off side
angling in towards middle, that's been defended off the back foot to point

What was Smith doing there? That didn't keep low at all and there was Smith, on his knees after going after a good length ball on middle, tried to smash it over the bowler's head, it nipped back in to knock out middle stump
fullish on middle and that's been flicked to deep square leg for a single
angling in towards middle, Tendulkar gets forward and drives it wide of mid-on for a couple of runs
short of a good length on the off and nips away, he tries to guide that to third man as well, misses
back of a length, gets back and punches it towards the extra cover fielder
on the pads and that's been flicked through square leg into the deep for a single
more controlled this time, guides that one down to third man for a single
four more, this time it's over slip, an ugly shot but it works, short of a length, tries to smack that past mid-off, gets a thick edge over Sammy

edged and wide of slip, Sammy was the man there, on a good length and it nipped away, got a thick edge as he tried to play that from the crease, didn't move his feet, went past first slip, the second slip was taken out for this over
caught high on the pad first ball as it comes in sharply and he misses the work to leg
just back of a length, he nudges this to square leg for a single
pushes this full and down the leg side as Smith moves across and misses
umpire Taufel shakes his head, this length ball nipped in sharply to catch him on the pad, doing too much, and hit him above the knee roll as well
this is clipped off the pads and Dhawan has to run to his right this time from deep square to keep them to two
hits him high on the pad with a skiddy short of a length ball

just out of the reach of deep square leg running to his left, this was some timing from Smith, he skipped out and flicked this length ball, Dhawan tried to reach it with an outstretched left hand, in vain
pitches this outswinger further up, Smith comes forward and pushes to short extra, who can't stop it and allows a single, Steyn's glare reads 'not impressed'
another away swinger, starts outside off, bounces and is allowed to go past
good length outswinger left alone outside off
shot, that was not short at all, but Smith's mowed it to the deep square leg boundary, umpire Taufel gets out of the way just in time
this length ball carries straight in with the angle and hits him on the pads
straightening quick and right on off and middle from good length, defended
